name: ltx-2-3-distilled
license: Apache-2.0 (free for personal and commercial use)

audio.notes: LTX-2.3 generates synchronized audio in the same forward pass as the video. Best for ambient sound, foley, and environmental effects — not for music or voice. For music or human speech, use stable-audio-3 or kokoro-tts respectively.

resources.videoSecondsTypical: ~20-40s per 5s clip (121 frames @ 24fps) on RTX 4090; ~60-120s on RTX 4070 Ti

notes: Distilled variant of LTX-2.3 (released March 2026, 22B-parameter base, ~8B distilled). The right Safebox default for video — Apache 2.0 means commercial use without license drama, 16GB VRAM minimum fits on consumer cards, and 8-step inference makes iteration fast enough for actual workflow use. Text-to-video, image-to-video, AND synchronized audio (LTX-2.3 generates audio in the same forward pass as video — best for ambient sound and foley, not for music). Dimensions must be divisible by 32 (the runner clamps automatically). Frame counts of the form 8k+1 (the runner rounds automatically).
